name: context-meter
description: A context-usage bar and session cost above the prompt; asks before a request re-sends a big context to an expired prompt cache (continue, copy a handoff for a new session, or stop); can skip auto-compaction while uncommitted work is in progress

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the questions, notices and the handoff text

bar_scale.title: Bar scale
bar_scale.description: auto-compact: fill against CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW when it is set (the model's window when not); window: fill against the model's whole context window

warn_percent.title: Yellow from, %
warn_percent.description: The bar turns yellow at this fill

alert_percent.title: Red from, %
alert_percent.description: The bar turns red at this fill

show_cost.title: Show session cost
show_cost.description: Close the bar with the session's estimated cost in USD

show_in_terminal.title: Show the bar in the terminal
show_in_terminal.description: Off by default: a terminal usually has a status line with the same figures

cold_cache_check.title: Ask before writing a cold cache
cold_cache_check.description: Before a request that would re-send a big context to an expired prompt cache, ask: continue, copy a handoff for a new session, or stop

cold_cache_min_tokens.title: Ask from, tokens
cold_cache_min_tokens.description: A smaller context is re-sent without asking

handoff_quote_chars.title: Handoff quote length
handoff_quote_chars.description: Characters kept from your last request and from Claude's last message in the handoff

handoff_steps.title: Handoff: first steps
handoff_steps.description: What the new session is told to do first, closing the handoff; empty for nothing
handoff_steps.default: First run git status and git diff --stat to see where the work stands, then continue my last request.

compact_guard.title: Skip auto-compact while work is uncommitted
compact_guard.description: While git status shows uncommitted changes, an auto-compaction is skipped, so a summary does not cut a step in half

compact_guard_max_percent.title: Never skip past, % of window
compact_guard_max_percent.description: Past this share of the model's window auto-compaction always runs: one the engine starts because a prompt no longer fits fails the request when skipped

after_compact_note.title: Note after a compaction
after_compact_note.description: Told to Claude right after a compaction; empty for nothing
after_compact_note.default: The context was just compacted. Before continuing, re-read the task you were on and run git diff --stat.
